name: How long does cabinet ordering take for a kitchen remodel in California?

mainEntity.name: How long does cabinet ordering take for a kitchen remodel in California?
mainEntity.text: How long does cabinet ordering take for a kitchen remodel in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet ordering is one of the biggest schedule drivers in a kitchen remodel because lead times vary widely by product type. Stock cabinets may arrive relatively quickly, while semi-custom and fully custom cabinets can take much longer due to design approval, fabrication, finish work, and delivery coordination. In California, longer lead times are common when supply chains are busy or when homeowners make late changes to dimensions, door styles, or finishes. Since cabinets often determine countertop measurements and final installation dates, delays can affect the entire project timeline. Homeowners should finalize cabinet decisions early and confirm how the contractor handles measurement, ordering, damage replacement, and storage. It is also wise to ask when field measurements occur relative to demolition, because a misstep there can create expensive rework. If the kitchen is part of a larger luxury renovation, cabinet timing should be treated as a critical path item.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet lead times can range from a few weeks to several months depending on whether the cabinets are stock, semi-custom, or fully custom. Custom cabinetry usually takes the longest because it involves design approval, fabrication, finishing, and delivery scheduling. Delays are common when selections change late.
